# Featured

## Discovery of novel InhA inhibitors by structural bioinformatics and machine-learning QSAR

**First and corresponding author**

**Anthony, G. I.**, et al. (2026). Discovery of novel InhA inhibitors through structural bioinformatics and machine learning-driven QSAR screening of natural products. *Biology Methods and Protocols*, 11(1), bpag015. [doi:10.1093/biomethods/bpag015](https://doi.org/10.1093/biomethods/bpag015)

A machine-learning QSAR and structural-bioinformatics workflow for screening natural products against InhA, a validated tuberculosis target, integrating molecular descriptors, model evaluation, docking and molecular dynamics. [Figure and details on the Projects page](projects.qmd).

`Machine learning` · `QSAR` · `Molecular dynamics` · `Tuberculosis`

# Computational drug discovery

## Molecular AI for GRK5 ligand discovery

**First author**

**Anthony, G. I.**, Ogbozor, F. I., Atanda, D. O., Bodun, D. S., Folaranmi, I. O., Eguavoen, A. E., Olaide, T. H., Nwachukwu, F. U., Ohilebo, A. A., Okotie, G. E., Adubi, P. O., & Ayangoke, O. A. (2025). In silico evaluation of 4-quinolone ligands interacting with human G protein-coupled receptor kinase 5 using message-passing neural networks, molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulation. *Egyptian Journal of Medical Human Genetics*. [doi:10.1186/s43042-025-00780-x](https://doi.org/10.1186/s43042-025-00780-x)

Combines graph-based deep learning with structure-based modelling to evaluate 4-quinolone compounds against GRK5.

`Message-passing neural networks` · `Molecular docking` · `Molecular dynamics`

# Immunoinformatics and vaccine design

## Epitope-based vaccine candidate for Lassa mammarenavirus

**Co-author**

Abass, O. A., Timofeev, V. I., Sarkar, B., Onobun, D. O., Ogunsola, S. O., Aiyenuro, A. E., Aborode, A. T., Aigboje, A. E., Omobolanle, B. N., **Imolele, A. G.**, & Abiodun, A. A. (2022). Immunoinformatics analysis to design a novel epitope-based vaccine candidate targeting the glycoprotein and nucleoprotein of Lassa mammarenavirus using strains from Nigeria. *Journal of Biomolecular Structure and Dynamics*, 40(16), 7283–7302. [doi:10.1080/07391102.2021.1896387](https://doi.org/10.1080/07391102.2021.1896387)

Selects conserved CTL, HTL and B-cell epitopes from Lassa glycoprotein and nucleoprotein sequences and validates the construct by docking, molecular dynamics and immune simulation.

`Lassa fever` · `Immunoinformatics` · `Vaccine design`
